title: Kpop Demon Hunters tease massive Glasgow concert - Yahoo News UK
text:

 News Finance More Mail Search the web Advertisement Advertisement Return to homepage Kpop Demon Hunters announce massive Glasgow concert as part of world tour
 Kevin Maguire Fri, 13 November 2026 at 11:14 am UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. (Image: Supplied) A viral Kpop sensation has announced that it will be coming to Glasgow next year.
 The Kpop Demon Hunters will perform at the OVO Hydro on Tuesday, October 12, 2027.
 Gigs would involve the film's fiction band Huntrix performing their litany of hits written for the film.

 Their track Golden was the undeniable standout from the soundtrack, becoming the first K-pop song to reach number one in the UK since Gangnam Style by PSY .
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement It was also the first song from an animated song to do the same since We Don't Talk About Bruno from 2022's Encanto .
 The rest of the soundtrack was no less loved, spending a whopping 23 weeks on the top spot.
 A Mastercard presale will take place at 10am on Wednesday, November 18, with a For the Fans presale coming at the same time the following day.
 General sale will then come at 10am on Friday, November 20, with various packages available across all sale windows.
 (Image: Supplied) 
 AEG Presents President of Global Touring, Rich Schaefer: "KPop Demon Hunters has become a global phenomenon, with characters and music that already mean so much to fans around the world.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "We're excited to work with Netflix to bring that world to life on tour, with the music at the heart of a show that makes fans part of the adventure.
 "The Golden World Tour gives us the chance to create something special for this incredible audience and bring fans of every generation together to experience it."
